name: SAIRU / BLACKSITE
intent: A typographic sci-fi editorial portfolio that leads with an original SAIRU wordmark and invites recruiters to inspect real work and test honest offline prototypes.
principles: Continuous editorial project sequence rather than a dashboard or bento hero
Original vector geometry and licensed open-source typography
Warm black with industrial yellow as the primary signal

usage.signal: Wordmark, calls to action, active evidence selection and key rules
usage.annotation: Tiny technical notes only; never the dominant accent
usage.terminal: Terminal remains dark in both themes

wordmark.accessibleText: Sairu. Software, sistemas e IA aplicada.

mono.usage: Commands, labels, dates, small data and captions

shape.radius: Square editorial surfaces; round only the small status dot

wordmarkEntry.behavior: Single left-to-right clip reveal with -12px initial translation

motion.reducedMotion: Disable animations, transitions and smooth scrolling; ensure wordmark is fully revealed

components.hero: Full-width original geometric SAIRU wordmark, technical margin, yellow reverse type strip, asymmetric copy/CTA/barcode lower composition. No bento layout.
components.navigation: Desktop inline section anchors; toggleable yellow menu at <=520px, aria-expanded and menu-specific accessible label.
components.projectRow: Number and name above a real browser screenshot and editorial description. Primary test-demo CTA and visible source/tests link. Decorative screenshot link is hidden from the accessibility tree to avoid duplicate focus stops.
components.evidenceInspector: Selectable skill inventory with aria-pressed buttons, explicit experience/prototype status, evidence description and relevant source link; polite atomic live update.
components.biography: Yellow full-width section preserving paid software roles and education dates.
components.terminal: Deterministic local command exploration, labeled input, polite live log, clear/help/status/labs/stack/contact commands.
components.contact: Large typographic mailto invitation plus explicit email, GitHub and LinkedIn links.
components.themeControl: Local React light-mode toggle; aria-pressed. No persisted preference is implemented.

responsive.min1700: Increase hero top and lower spacing.
responsive.max1100: Reduce grid gaps and navigation spacing; hide hero barcode.
responsive.max760: Project sequence becomes one column; toolkit becomes one column with a two-column selector; readout loses sticky positioning.
responsive.max520: Mobile menu, one-column hero lower area and toolkit selector, stacked biography/contact, 23px gutters, simplified decorative details.

implemented: Screen-reader h1 equivalent for SVG wordmark
Labeled terminal input and polite live output
Pressed state for toolkit and theme buttons
Decorative geometry hidden from assistive technology
accessibility.verificationBoundary: This documents implementation, not a formal WCAG conformance audit. Check contrast, zoom, keyboard navigation and tiny decorative labels against the final rendered build.

contentConstraints: Preserve actual paid software experience, education, GitHub and contact information.
EvalForge, OpsPilot and DocTrace are exploratory offline demos with synthetic data.
Rules and local retrieval do not imply real LLM inference; an LLM via local proxy is optional where indicated.
Benchmarks and tests describe demos, not enterprise outcomes or production impact.
No commercial Cyber Grotesk font files or copyrighted reference artwork.

references.name: Cyber Grotesk
references.author: Olga Ryzhychenko
references.role: Typography and industrial editorial direction only

scope: Documentation only; no UI changes or publishing performed by this documentation task.
